notes:
## Bug fixes
- AURIS could crash when a list was rebuilt, for example the Source library inside Moving point sources, or when closing a dialog that held one.
- After the model changed, a Raw result kept being drawn as plain cells whatever contour method or Simplify/Smoothing setting you chose, with no warning. It is now marked out of date, and a lasting message names the method you picked and asks you to press Update Grid.
- Interpolated at Raw detail now shows the calculated cells, as its description says.
